translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Kaliva sifi saꞋeyana ginuhegena-ma ana gahetalahobuhobu.
Tova saꞋeyana takesi ana toyaudi kadu tokoyona velugadiyao moyaꞋaidi Yesu againe hiyoꞋoyoꞋo be bonana hinanogalina.
Tu tonagona tafatafalolodiyao adi egana Falisi kadu Mosese yana vehimeya ana tovehawala hivebutu hiꞋalawoluwolu higayo, “Medema kaliva tokoyona givevetobohiyanedi buye hiꞋauꞋa.”

Au hidede amine higahe faꞋina Yesu hida gahetalahobuhobu agaidiya gilukahihiyena gigayo, “KaꞋi kaliva saꞋeyana agaimiya yana sifi 100 tu saꞋeyana gidanuhegena, gavaimi gidagani? Au sifi 99 ubuleya gidanuyabuyabudi tu sifi ginuhegena-ma gidalelena. Gidalelelena gidanunauwena tu gidanuhagana.
Ada ahe gidanuhagana againe, gidaꞋavalana be yana wavemwamwala gidanauwena yana manuweya.
Ada ahe gidayemu-yo tobohiyaneyao be yana yoꞋo gidakovavagaꞋauhidi gidagahedi gidagayo, Omi buye kanavemwamwala, faꞋina yaku sifi ganuhegena-ma ahe ganuhagana.

Gagahemi meda anafaiweya tokoyona saꞋeyana yana nuwavilana faꞋina vemwamwala lakahi-moꞋena lobameya ginalakayemu, tu yamumudiyao 99 au yegayegadiyao faꞋina keke hidanuwavilani-ma badi faꞋidiya vemwamwala maꞋita.” Au hidedemi Yesu gigahetalahobuhobu.
Kwamayoku yadi mani siliva teni tu saꞋeyana
hinuhegena-ma ana gahetalahobuhobu.

Kadu Yesu gigayo, “KaꞋi kwamayoku yadi siliva teni tu saꞋeyana hidanuhegena digo, gavaimi hidagani? Lamufa hidakabuna manuwa matatabuna hidagili-Ꞌowona be hidalelena. Hidalele-hagihagiyena hidanunauwena tu hidanuhagana.
Ada ahe hidanuhagana againe tobohiyadiyao be yadi yoꞋo hidakovavagaꞋauhidi hidagayo, Omi buye kanavemwamwala faꞋina yama mani siliva anuhegena-ma ahe anuhagana.
Gagahemi meda anafaiweya tokoyona saꞋeyana yana nuwavilana faꞋina Yaubada yana tovenuwaꞋata hivemwamwala.”
Yaubada yana hinekalikali tokoyona faꞋidiya Yesu givehawala.
Kadu gahetalahobuhobu anaveto Yesu gilukahihiyena gigayo, “Kaliva saꞋeyana natuneyao luhei.
Ada kwamaneya tamana againe gigahe gigayo, Kamaku, lokoloko aku duꞋu ma udaveleku. Au yana lokoloko natuneyao agaidiya gifolakena.

Himiyami aiyeta keke moyaꞋaina tu kwamaneya yana lokoloko moyaꞋaina givagakokona, gilowoga be gina lauveya mali fafali againe gimiyami. Medede againe gakahikahi tulina tulina agaidiya yana mani giluyauyaulena.
Tu ahe yana mani givehavaidi-yo mena fafali-nadi againe lokabudubudula gilakayemu, au givebutu mafu gilaulauna anaga keke.
Au gina melalai-nadi ana kaliva-lakata saꞋeyana againe giveꞋagetoga. Ada givegidena be ginana yana babi saꞋeyana againe yana bawe ginaꞋitaveꞋavidi.
Ada nuwanuwana lakahina bawe adi bini aꞋa fwayafwayana againe ginaꞋahiyauwa tu keke tamo hakwadi maꞋi aꞋa gidaveleni.
Gimiyami tu nuwanuwa ayaugina a givaina be giꞋayaunena againe gigayo, Kwavakwavaku. Kamaku yana tofaisewa yuwa adi waga tu iyaꞋeku ma hidedei mafulaugeya ganaꞋalika.
Ganamidi be kamaku againe ganana ada bana againe ganagahe ganagayo, Kamaku ahe gakoyo Yaubada matane kadu o mataniya.
Keke gidalubodaku be unahawavenatuneku. Au unavehimeyeku be ya tofaisewa amine ganamiyami. Au hidedemi tauna nuwahinage gigahe.
Au gitowamidi be gilowoga tamana againe. Aimo lauveya giꞋelaꞋela tu tamana giꞋitana be gihinekalikaliyena. Au gimadu giꞋatulauhina giveyaugina.
Au kwamana gigahe gigayo, Kamaku, Yaubada matane kadu o mataniya ahe gakoyo ada keke gidalubodaku be unahawavenatuneku.
Au hidedemi gigahe tu tamana ana agetoga gigahedi gigayo, Wamadu, vaigau yamumu-moꞋena waꞋaliye be waveꞋoseni, kadu nimalukabubu nimane wahifo, ageyafayafa agene waseni.
Bulumakau natudi veveꞋahiyauwana waꞋaliyeni be wamunu. Avemwamwala againe kanavemwamwala-moꞋa.
FaꞋina natuku vaita gidaꞋalika tu ahe giyemu-havagi, kadu vaita gadanuhegeni tu ahe ganuhagana. Au hivebutu hikidewadewa be hivemwamwala.
Badi yadi wavemwamwala hiꞋauꞋa tu tomoꞋainagona faheya gimiyami be giyewayewana melaleya. Manuwa liline giyemu tu alata kadu vaga ginogalina.
Au agetoga saꞋeyana giyowanina be giꞋela ada gitoliluveluvena gigayo, Wada gavaimi-yo modawa butuna ganogalini?
Ma agetoga gigayo, Me o taini a giꞋela ada tama gigahe be bulumakau veveꞋahiyauwana ahe amununa, higa natuna wayawaina ginuhagana faꞋina.
Au tomoꞋainagona giꞋilaꞋa ada manuwa ana luku gidibutoyogena. Medema faꞋina bana tamana gihobu gihawanuwenuwena vaita ginaluku.

Tu tamana againe gibonalaufata gigayo, UꞋita, hida malamala moyaꞋaina againiya gaveveꞋagetoga. Ya vehimeya keke tamo gadadibutoyogeni tu keke tamo udaveleku, keke-moꞋa. Keke tamo kevakeva kabiꞋona manugose natudi amine udaveleku-yo tobohiyakweyao buye adavemwamwala.
Tu wama natu ya lokoloko vevine yamayamadadadiyao agaidiya gihebana amanadi bana faꞋine bulumakau veveꞋahiyauwana umununa.
Tamana gigahena gigayo, Ho natuku, tova moyaꞋaina o iya buye kamimiyami. Yaku gaitoma moyaꞋaina kadu ya gaitoma.
Au gilubodada be kanaꞋavemwamwala, faꞋina taini vaita gidaꞋalika tu giyemu-havagi, kadu vaita kadanuhegeni tu ahe kanuhagana.” Au hidedemi Yesu yana gahetalahobuhobu.
